title: No Wheat From Grass
description: Wheat seeds no longer drop from grass/fern
body:
With this mod, wheat seeds can no longer be obtained from breaking grass or fern blocks.

This incentives players to explore for villages to obtain wheat before they could start farming for crops and animals.

As a small bonus, this also makes landscaping a little less annoying now that seeds won't be cluttering your inventory.
